text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and fifty-five is hereby amended to read as
"Section 1. The names of the streets of the municipality of Tacloban, Province of Leyte, hereinafter named are
hereby replaced by the following: Calle Colon by Paseo de Colon, San Fernando by Avenida Magallanes, San
Juan by Juan Luna, Job by P. Paterno, Malcampo by M. H. del Pilar, Gumersindo by Purisima Concepcion,
San Roque by San Roque, Amparo by P. Gomez, Paseo del Carmen by P. Gomez (extension), Pelayo. by
Trece Martires, Guzman by Presidente Wilson, Pizarro by Lopez Jaena, Rizal by Avenida Rizal, all of Calle
Rizal and Calle Gran Capitan, to the intersection of Calles Real and Gran Capitan, San Jose by Perikohon,
Allen by Jones, Sevilla by T. Claudio, Santa Filomena by F. Torres, Zaragoza by Independencia, Bailon by C.
Arellano, Gerona by General Lukban, and Calle Nueva or Veloso by Avenida Veteranos de la Revolucion."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1930.
